goal: Make internal self-transfers and UTXO consolidations visible in wallet transaction listings
Provide a raw transaction listing RPC without category filtering or change suppression
agreement: Unanimous support after addressing review feedback on helpers, pagination, and output formatting
Verified single entries for self-sends and pagination by testing on regtest (BrandonOdiwuor)
Strong support for decoded transaction output via verbose parameter (Bicaru20)

categories.name: wallet
why: P3 because it exposes internal change-only spends and UTXO consolidations previously invisible to users
Provides integrators and wallet users a reliable way to view all raw wallet transactions
